name: Intuit TurboTax
description: TurboTax is Intuit's consumer tax preparation and filing product for federal and state returns, tax documents, calculations, expert assistance, and electronic filing.
agentUseSummary: Intuit TurboTax cannot currently be connected as an autonomous Relay provider. Intuit offers a provider-managed TurboTax experience inside ChatGPT, but does not publish a Relay-distributable API or remote MCP endpoint, stable tool schemas, OAuth scopes, service credentials, revocation contract, or authorization boundary. Relay will not reuse a TurboTax or ChatGPT session, capture credentials, upload tax documents, infer private endpoints, calculate or file returns, or transfer authority from a consumer connector.

blocked.label: Connect TurboTax through an unsupported session
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse a TurboTax or ChatGPT browser session, capture Intuit credentials or tokens, automate interactive consent, or infer a private authorization contract.

blocked.label: Access private tax data
blocked.description: Tax returns, W-2/1099 forms, income, deductions, credits, dependents, government identifiers, addresses, bank details, investments, property, health coverage, and uploaded documents are blocked without a supported least-privilege API contract.

blocked.label: Prepare or calculate taxes
blocked.description: Tax interviews, refund or liability estimates, checklists based on account data, return calculations, form selection, tax advice, expert matching, and return review are blocked.

blocked.label: File returns or move money
blocked.description: Federal or state filing, amendments, signatures, attestations, fee purchases, refund routing, tax payments, bank changes, expert authorization, and every other consequential action are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported TurboTax automation
blocked.description: Dashboard scraping, private endpoint discovery, document upload, UI automation, raw connector pass-through, account impersonation, and commercial or professional tax preparation are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No TurboTax action can be enabled without a supported public authorization and tool contract designed for third-party autonomous use.

runtimeSupport.description: The provider-managed TurboTax ChatGPT experience does not publish a distributable OpenClaw API/MCP authorization or tool contract.
The provider-managed TurboTax ChatGPT experience does not publish a distributable Hermes API/MCP authorization or tool contract.

providerSetup.blocker: TurboTax is a consumer tax-preparation and filing product handling extremely sensitive tax and identity data. Intuit documents a provider-managed ChatGPT connection, but no public Relay-usable API/MCP endpoint, stable tool schemas, OAuth scopes, service credentials, revocation lifecycle, or third-party autonomous authorization boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Intuit credentials, reuse a ChatGPT/TurboTax session, upload documents, scrape TurboTax, calculate or file returns, or automate tax experts. Reconsider only if Intuit publishes a supported third-party API or remote MCP contract with versioned schemas, least-privilege scopes, revocation, taxpayer binding, audit semantics, tax-data retention controls, and explicit confirmation for every calculation, filing, signature, payment, purchase, bank, or expert action.

evidence.supports: Intuit documents provider-managed TurboTax tools in ChatGPT for estimates, filing-option exploration, expert connection, personalized checklists, account connection, and document upload, but does not publish an external endpoint, tool schema, OAuth scope, credential, or Relay-distributable authorization contract.
TurboTax Online handles tax interviews, sensitive document upload/import, income and deduction data, expert assistance, return preparation, fees, and filing across complex personal tax situations.

TurboTax licensing restricts consumer use to the user's own returns, prohibits commercial or professional tax preparation, and prohibits unauthorized collection of confidential information or attempts to probe or breach Intuit systems.
